title: agent-hook shim protocol v1: the response
description: What the agent-hook binary writes on stdout for a shim request, with exit 0: one JSON object and a newline. A post hook's notice goes on stderr; the shim decides how to show it. The binary checks its answer templates against this schema when it loads a shim harness.

action.description: pass: the call goes on as it is; block: the call is stopped, with the reason; rewrite: the call goes on with the input fields in set.

reason.description: Why the call is blocked, as the model is told. Not blank.

set.description: rewrite only: the new value of each input field the binary rewrites. Only command, today.
